messages:
Mei Park: Quick check-in on the shim that normalizes new model output to the legacy /v1 schema. We prototyped mapping + pruning yesterday.
Gabriel Ortiz: Saw it, looks clean. Main worry: added latency for chat streaming when we run the field mapping step per-chunk.
Mei Park: Yes — today's numbers: median added CPU ~8ms/token, p99 ~120ms when run synchronously. I pushed an async path that does streaming passthrough + post-process for compatibility, but then clients expecting immediate fields may miss them.
Leo Kim: Can we emit a short header in the stream saying `compat_pending` so clients can choose to wait?
Gabriel Ortiz: +1. Also need to decide if this is tenant-opt-in. Some large customers want strict 100% field parity.
Mei Park: Propose config: `tenant.compat_mode` = {"strict","best_effort","passthrough"}. Default `best_effort`. `strict` forces sync mapping and blocks chunk until mapped.
Leo Kim: Tradeoff: strict = higher tail latency and higher cost. Need SLO exemption or dedicated capacity option.
Mei Park: Documented candidate rollout: canary (internal + 3 tenants) -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 2 weeks. Metric gates: no >3x p99 increase, no more than 5% error rate of missing fields.
ops-bot: perf-tests/compat-shim: completed. Latency delta: +7ms median, +110ms p99 on small-chat benchmark. Logs: http://ci.redwood/test/1234
Gabriel Ortiz: Add telemetry: `shim_applied`, `shim_mode`, `mapping_errors`, `skipped_fields`. Ensure PII redaction remains.
Mei Park: Mapping rules: keep a deterministic remapper table (proto). We'll sign the table with key rotation so private deployments can audit.
Leo Kim: Anything for embeddings consumers? Some embed clients expect fixed dims; not the same problem but need a separate compatibility shim for dim changes.
Mei Park: Agreed — opened ENG-ML issue #452. For this thread let's finalize API surface: header `X-Compat-Mode` and streaming meta-frame `compat_state`.
Gabriel Ortiz: Ack. I'll draft a tiny RFC for header + telemetry and attach canary config. Mei, can you add the async passthrough fallback implementation into the runtime checklist?
Mei Park: Will do. Plan to flip canary tomorrow 06:00 PT. Tagging @deploy-bot to schedule.
deploy-bot: Scheduled canary rollout for compat-shim -> cluster-internal at 2026-03-22T06:00:00Z :rocket:
Mei Park: Postmortem guardrails: if errors > 0.5% during canary rollback immediately and open PagerDuty.
Gabriel Ortiz: Good. One last note — ensure we have end-to-end tests simulating slow mapping to validate backpressure behavior.
Mei Park: Ack, adding tests now.
